* [Edit](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Bosses&action=edit§ion=0) * [](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Special:UserLogin&returnto=Bosses "Add this page to your watchlist [w]") Bosses ====== Bosses are unique challenges in the game that have their own unique [maps](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Maps "Maps") on where they spawn and are typically the hardest [enemies](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies "Enemies") in the game that will challenge your defense. For more information regarding bosses, click [here](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies#Bosses "Enemies") . | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | * [![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/a/ab/Betsy_Herself.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Betsy)

**Betsy**


**The mother of all wyverns, protector of The Liferoot.**
_Found in [The Wyvern Den](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/The_Wyvern_Den "The Wyvern Den")
Campaign and Incursion._

[![Betsy Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/5/52/Betsy_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Betsy "Betsy") | * [![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/b/b3/The_Harbinger.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Harbinger)

**The Harbinger**


**An agent of chaos wreaking havoc on Etheria to free its master.**
_Found in [Harbinger's Warship](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Harbinger%27s_Warship "Harbinger's Warship")
Adventures and Incursion._

[![The Harbinger Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/d/d0/The_Harbinger_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Harbinger "Harbinger") | * [![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/a/a3/Demon_Lord_NoBackground.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Demon_Lord)

**Demon Lord**


**A being born in magma, ruler of the underworld.**
_Found in The Demon's Lair Incursion._

[![Demon Lord Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/c/c3/Demon_Lord_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Demon_Lord "Demon Lord") | | * [![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/b/b3/Phoenix_NoBackground.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Phoenix)

**Phoenix**


**A mythical bird born of fire.**
_Found in [Embermount Volcano](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Embermount_Volcano "Embermount Volcano")
Expeditions._

[![Icon Phoenix.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/7/74/Icon_Phoenix.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Phoenix "Phoenix") | * [![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/3/34/Genie_King.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Genie_King)

**Genie King**


**A supernatural creature able to manipulate the elements.**
_Found in [Tornado Highlands](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Tornado_Highlands "Tornado Highlands")
Expeditions._

[![Icon GenieKing.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/b/b6/Icon_GenieKing.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Genie_King "Genie King") | * [![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/2/26/Hidden_Caverns_Enemy_-_Lava_Beast.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Lava_Beast)

**Lava Beast**


**A giant mutated Witherbeast.**
_Found in [Crystal Mine](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Crystal_Mine "Crystal Mine")
Expeditions._

[![Lava Beast Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/0/04/Lava_Beast_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Lava_Beast "Lava Beast") | | * [![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/b/bf/Lord_Malakai.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Lord_Malakai)

**Lord Malakai**


**An ancient vampiric lord who feasts on the essence of the living.**
_Found in [Malakai's Manor](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Malakai%27s_Manor "Malakai's Manor")
Expeditions._

[![Lord Malakai Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/b/b3/Lord_Malakai_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Lord_Malakai "Lord Malakai") | * [![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/5/53/King_Aquarion.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/King_Aquarion)

**King Aquarion**


**A once benevolent king twisted into a conquest-driven tyrant.**
_Found in [Aquarion Throne Room](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Aquarion_Throne_Room "Aquarion Throne Room")
Expeditions._

[![King Aquarion Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/f/f9/King_Aquarion_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Lord_Malakai "Lord Malakai") | * [![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/3/3f/Eye_of_Cthulhu_Phase_2.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Eye_of_Cthulhu)

**Eye of Cthulhu**


**A dangerous foe from another world sent to Etheria.**
_Found in Dawn of the Blood Moon Incursion._

[![Eye of Cthulhu Terraria Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/9/92/Eye_of_Cthulhu_Terraria_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Eye_of_Cthulhu "Eye of Cthulhu") | Retrieved from "[https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Bosses&oldid=22456](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Bosses&oldid=22456) " [Last edited on 20 August 2024, at 04:00](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Special:History/Bosses)
